name: Adina Vălean - Proposition de la Commission et amendement
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulations (EU) No 1024/2012 and (EU) 2018/1724 as regards certain requirements laid down by Directive (EU) XXXX/XXXX
part_text:
The European Parliament has agreed its position on a planned new law on transparency for people who lobby on behalf of countries outside the European Union. The report makes one change: it updates the list of articles in that future law whose rules would be handled through an existing EU computer system. That system lets authorities across the EU share information electronically. The report does not change the substance of the planned law itself; it only adjusts which of its articles plug into that system.

- **What changes:** One list of articles in an existing EU information-sharing system is updated.
- **Who it affects:** Authorities and people covered by the future lobbying transparency law.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's position goes to EU governments for negotiation.
